Start with the content rather than choosing a comment quantity in isolation. Review the subject, caption, existing activity and purpose of the post before deciding where additional visible conversation makes sense.

Creators may receive real questions about their work, process, recommendations or the subject of a Reel. Use first-hand information when replying rather than treating every comment as another engagement number.
